facility.name: Home Sweet Home Childcare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 16618 CLAY RD, HOUSTON, TX, 77084

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: Based on information received during the investigation the director did not ensure training was given to the caregiver before having unsupervised access to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information obtained during the investigation it was determined that the caregiver did not see a child enter the restroom for 11 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Based on information obtained, the employee stated that she did not receive any training before having unsupervised access to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - By Telephone if for a Single Dose: Based on information obtained from interviews, the director administered Tylenol without approval from the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - By Telephone if for a Single Dose (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: While waiting for someone to open the door a child was observed walking to their classroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device.     Note: The owner removed the infant from the rocker.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 3 out 8 children did not have immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: The television in the Two's & Threes room was sitting on a table not anchored. Note: The TV was moved during the  inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: 5 out of 8 files reviewed did not have the health statement section completed on the admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Date: 5 out of 8 of the staff files reviews did not have the dates of when trainings were completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Date (26 TAC §746.1329(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Operation did not report the number of employees who left in 2024
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 4 out of 8 children did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Exemptions for Immunization Requirements Must Meet Criteria Specified by DSHS: 1 out 8 children did have a current immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Exemptions for Immunization Requirements Must Meet Criteria Specified by DSHS (26 TAC §746.615(a))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Safety Requirements for After-school Care in A Public Facility: There were two play equipment in the outside play area that was broken.     Note: One play equipment was repaired during the inspection and the other one was removed from the play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Safety Requirements for After-school Care in A Public Facility (26 TAC §746.4601(11))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Based on the investigation and information obtained there were sufficient evidence to conclude a highchair and a seat at the toddler table had missing safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: A 17 month old infant was observed sleeping in a bouncer for approximately 15 minutes before being moved to a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: The Director is missing 13 hours of required annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A 5 year old child was left in the office for 10 minutes with the Licensing Inspector, then the child woke up and walked out to the front lobby entrance and stood by the front door until the Director intervened approximately 5 minutes later.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The emergency preparedness plan is missing how the child care staff will continue to care for the children after the emergency occurs and how they will reunify the children with their parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: 2 caregivers CPR/First Aid training has expired.    2 caregivers have invalid CPR training taken online only.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Fire inspection was last conducted November 3, 2022 and is now expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A 5 month old infant was not strapped in a bouncer during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: 2 caregivers FA/CPR expired.    2 caregivers CPR is invalid becuase it was completed online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The electronic child safety alarm on the vehicle used to transport  children was not working during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Transportation: The written operational policy does not have transportation included.    Note: The written operational policy does not have transportation included.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Transportation (26 TAC §746.501(a)(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The operation did not have the playground maintenance checklist available upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission: 2 out of 5 children in care did not have consent from parents to transport.    Note: 4 out of 5 children in care did not have consent from parents to transport.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission (26 TAC §746.605(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: I observed no list of children being transported in the vehicle, no emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms. The vehicle also did not have the child-care center director or permit holder s name, no center telephone number in the glove compartment and was not clearly visible inside the passenger compartment. The vehicle also did not have the parent s names, telephone numbers and emergency telephone numbers for each child being transported. The vehicle did not have a fire extinguisher approved by the local or state fire marshal and was not secured in the passenger compartment.      Note: The operation was still missing emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported and a fire extinguisher approved by the local or state fire marshal, secured in the passenger compartment and accessible to the adult occupants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation of Services added such as: Transportation and Drop In Care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §746.301(7))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: During the inspection I observed, a tall pole on the playground, large holes in both fenecs, a bungee cord, no lock on the outdoor storage box, no padding around the poles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: I observed 9 infants in the classroom with one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission: 2 out of 5 children in care did not have consent from parents to transport.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission (26 TAC §746.605(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: I observed no list of children being transported in the vehicle, no emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms. The vehicle also did not have the child-care center director or permit holder s name, no center telephone number in the glove compartment and was not clearly visible inside the passenger compartment. The vehicle also did not have the parent s names, telephone numbers and emergency telephone numbers for each child being transported. The vehicle did not have a fire extinguisher approved by the local or state fire marshal and was not secured in the passenger compartment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: I observed the director and a caregiver who transports, have no transportation training available upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Transportation: The written operational policy does not have transportation included.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Transportation (26 TAC §746.501(a)(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The operation did not have the playground maintenance checklist available upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: I observed a caregiver on a personal laptop device while supervising children in care.     Note: During the inspection the caregiver removed the device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have the most recent fire inspection report available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: I observed 24 children in a classroom including infants with one caregiver. The youngest child in the room was 17 months. The oldest child in the room was 5 years old.     Note: A caregiver showed up to relieve the other teacher and the children were all put back in the correct classes, according to ages.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: I observed a caregiver leave the room with 7 children ages 18 months-23 months for any extended time frame. The caregiver was also on a personal device.     Note: Supervision was discussed, however the citation was recited. I observed two sharp objects accessible to children in the kitchen. I also observed a caregiver leave a classroom with 9 children  in care, ages 2-3 years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: I observed ten children ages 18 months through 23 months and a 3 year old being supervised by one caregiver in the rear classroom.  The maximum number of children in this age group that one caregiver may supervise is nine.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: I observed a caregiver leave the room with 7 children ages 18 months-23 months for any extended time frame. The caregiver was also on a pesonal device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: I observed while outdoors standing water, tarp that covers the play equipment in need of repair, the gate to the the electric box open and the back gate open.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: I observed two cribs in the infant classroom without snug fitted sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: I observed three play yards in the infant classroom without snug fitted sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the inspection I observed a electrical box that was lifted out of the wall exposing wires, Broken fence boards on the playground as well as a wooden deck with the astro turf covering ripped and torn, broken plastic toys as well as debris on the ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: During the walkthrough I observed a caregiver without a cleared eligible background results caring for 22 children ages 2-3 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))
